-- Dataplex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_resource_lookup
ON public.resource_timestamps (database_oid, resource_type, resource_oid)

-- Dataplex
INSERT INTO public.resource_timestamps (database_oid, resource_oid, resource_type, create_time, update_time)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW() AT TIME ZONE $4, NOW() AT TIME ZONE $5)
ON CONFLICT (database_oid, resource_type, resource_oid) DO NOTHING

-- Dataplex
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.resource_timestamps (
    database_oid BIGINT NOT NULL,
    resource_oid BIGINT NOT NULL,
    resource_type CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
    create_time TIMESTAMP(6) WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
    update_time TIMESTAMP(6) WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL
)

-- Orders
CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id    SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
    status      VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'pending',
    total       NUMERIC(10, 2),
    created_at  TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
)
